name: claude-mux
description: Real-time web dashboard for monitoring and controlling multiple Claude Code sessions

scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:web
scripts.dev:serve: while true; do (cd web && bun run dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3434); echo 'Dev server crashed, restarting in 2s...'; sleep 2; done
scripts.prod:restart: bun run build && bun dist/cli.js setup --yes && (pkill -9 -f 'bun dist/cli\.js serve --port 3456' 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3456 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; lsof -ti:3456 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; if lsof -ti:3456 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: port 3456 still busy after kill, aborting' >&2; lsof -i:3456 >&2; exit 1; fi; nohup bun dist/cli.js serve --port 3456 --host 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/claude-mux-prod.log 2>&1 & disown); echo 'Prod server restarted on 127.0.0.1:3456 (logs: /tmp/claude-mux-prod.log)'
scripts.version:
bun -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; require('fs').writeFileSync('src/utils/version.ts', '/**
 * Central version constant for claude-watch.
 * Keep in sync with package.json version.
 */
export const VERSION = "'+v+'";
')" && git add src/utils/version.ts

author: Leonardo Christino
